title: Movies That Deserved an Oscar
intro: Some films hit harder than any trophy ever could. These ones got away, and the wound is still fresh.

films.title: Prisoners
films.line: A father's desperation unravels into something far darker than the crime itself.

films.title: Zodiac
films.line: An obsession that consumes years of lives without ever offering closure.

films.title: Uncut Gems
films.line: Every scene tightens the coil until you forget to breathe entirely.

films.title: A Prophet
films.line: A young man enters prison invisible and leaves as something truly formidable.

films.title: Nightcrawler
films.line: Ambition wears a hollow smile and the city at night rewards it.

films.title: Requiem for a Dream
films.line: Four dreams dissolve in slow motion and you feel every single loss.

films.title: Burning
films.line: A slow beautiful mystery that lingers under your skin long after the credits roll.

films.title: Frailty
films.line: A father receives a divine mission and his sons must decide what to believe.
